skills.name: job-search
skills.description: Find IT jobs and freelance missions in France on GetYourJob that fit the user - search with filters, compare offers, check how pay sits against the market, and save the ones worth applying to. Use when the user asks for job offers, missions, "offres", "missions freelance", or wants to compare or shortlist offers.
skills.description_zh: 在 GetYourJob 查找法国 IT 岗位和自由职业任务，按条件筛选、比较报价、对照市场薪酬并保存值得申请的机会。

skills.name: prepare-application
skills.description: Prepare a strong application to an IT job on GetYourJob - run AI matching on the user's profile, explain the fit and the missing skills, then produce a tailored action plan and cover letter, and track the application status. Use when the user asks which offers match them, how to apply, for a "lettre de motivation", a "plan d'action", or to update where an application stands.
skills.description_zh: 通过 GetYourJob AI 匹配用户资料与 IT 职位，解释匹配和技能缺口，制定行动计划及定制求职信，并跟踪申请状态。
